component.name: Photon
component.summary: Cull and organise photos, with darktable round trips

description.p: Photon is a fast, non-destructive photo manager and culling workstation for GNOME. It never changes your originals: ratings, picks, rejects, colour labels and keywords go to XMP sidecars that darktable and other tools read and write too.

ul.li: Safe imports from cards, cameras and folders, verified and with an optional backup copy
Keyboard culling with ratings, picks, rejects, colour labels and compare mode
RAW, JPEG, HEIC, AVIF and video, with 1:1 zoom
Optional, local AI quality analysis: blur, missed focus, exposure and an aesthetic score
Albums, events, hierarchical keywords and smart collections
Export with colour management, metadata and your darktable edits

description.p: This build uses your own darktable, exiftool and editors, and keeps its library in the same folders as a build from source.
A learned aesthetic score with a crop check, restoring rejected photos from Photo Quality, and Move Rejects to Trash. Linux builds are now a Flatpak.
